name: Old Fire-Eye
summary: Lumina Windsinger sends you after Old Fire-Eye in Silverpine Forest with the Moonsilver Blade. The Windshapers await his death, and Lumina hopes the blade will guide you well.

sections.title: A Blade's Purpose
sections.body: The Windshapers have given you the Moonsilver Blade. Locals say Old Fire-Eye hunts across a wide stretch south of here, usually near the gates to Gilneas. Lumina asks you to find him and use the blade to end him. The Windshapers' gratitude depends on his death.

sections.title: After the Hunt
sections.body: When you return, Lumina thanks you and says Banon may rest in peace. Then she lays a small measure of her people's magic upon the bloodstained blade, hoping the winds will guide it well.

faq.q: Who is asking me to hunt Old Fire-Eye?
faq.answer: Lumina Windsinger asks you to hunt Old Fire-Eye with the Moonsilver Blade.

faq.q: Where can I find Old Fire-Eye?
faq.answer: Locals say Old Fire-Eye hunts across a wide area south of Lumina, usually near the gates to Gilneas.

faq.q: What should I use against Old Fire-Eye?
faq.answer: Lumina asks you to use the Moonsilver Blade to end Old Fire-Eye.

faq.q: Why does Lumina want Old Fire-Eye slain?
faq.answer: Lumina says the Windshapers will be grateful when Old Fire-Eye is dead.
Lumina says Banon may rest in peace after Old Fire-Eye is slain.

faq.q: What does Lumina do with the blade?
faq.answer: Lumina lays a small measure of her people's magic upon the bloodstained Moonsilver Blade.
